rules.statement: A long lease, unless the Court is satisfied that there were good reasons for its being granted, would be scrutinized very closely by the Court before whom it was challenged.
rules.supporting_quote: "The object of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, 1905, is to prevent unduly prolonged alienation of the properties devoted to religious use, and a long lease, unless the Court is satisfied that there were good reasons for its being granted, would be scrutinized very closely by the Court before whom it was challenged."

meta.parties: Banda v. Rosehaugh Tea Amd Rubber Co., Ltd
